title: Fast Staggered DID Estimation — fastdid
text: data data.table, dataset. timevar character, name time variable. cohortvar character, name cohort (group) variable. unitvar character, name unit (id) variable. outcomevar character vector, name(s) outcome variable(s). control_option character, control units used estimates, options "", "never", "notyet". result_type character, type result return, options "group_time", "time", "group", "simple", "dynamic" (time since event), "group_group_time", "dynamic_stagger". balanced_event_time number, max event time balance cohort composition. control_type character, estimator controlling covariates, options "ipw" (inverse probability weighting), "reg" (outcome regression), "dr" (doubly-robust). allow_unbalance_panel logical, allow unbalance panel input coerce dataset one. boot logical, whether use bootstrap standard error. biters number, bootstrap iterations. Default 1000. cband logical, whether use uniform confidence band point-wise. alpha number, significance level. Default 0.05. weightvar character, name weight variable. clustervar character, name cluster variable. covariatesvar character vector, names time-invariant covariate variables. varycovariatesvar character vector, names time-varying covariate variables. copy logical, whether copy dataset. validate logical, whether validate dataset. anticipation number, periods anticipation. anticipation2 number, periods anticipation second event. base_period character, type base period pre-preiods, options "universal", "varying". exper list, arguments experimental features. Supported options: `only_est_min` numeric scalar, minimum event time estimate (`result_type == "dynamic"` , compatible double ). `only_est_max` numeric scalar, maximum event time estimate (`result_type == "dynamic"` , compatible double ). `filtervar` character, name logical column; units TRUE base period used. `filtervar_post` character, name logical column; units TRUE post period used. `only_balance_2by2` logical, keep units observed periods 2x2 . `aggregate_scheme` character, custom aggregation expression evaluated `group_time[, target := <expr>]`. `max_control_cohort_diff` numeric, maximum cohort difference treated control groups. full logical, whether return full result (influence function, call, weighting scheme, etc,.). parallel logical, whether use parallization unix system. cohortvar2 character character vector, name(s) confounding event cohort variable(s). M>2 events, provide vector length M-1 (e.g., `c("G2", "G3")` M=3 events). event_specific logical, whether recover target treatment effect use combined effect. double_control_option character, control units used double , options "", "never", "notyet". "notyet" keeps control cohort every confounding event finite later period, control must confounded eventually . M >= 3 events can leave control cohorts, "" recommended option. add_base_period logical, whether add placeholder base period dynamic results.

title: fastdid 1.0.7
text: Fixed double control set case: M >= 3 events control cohort event target cohort used, biased ATT^1. control must now yet confounded every event case double now reported post-periods first event , theorem states Fixed influence function double weights: weights signed pair period normalized Fixed control cohorts double first-stage cell missing: periods now normalize cohorts available anticipation2 now moves boundary direct case, enters -yet-treated control cutoff first stage Added validation confounding cohort columns: missing value drops unit warning, fractional value raises error Added warning event-specific post-period effect identified cohort Fixed small-group variance understatement: residual influence 2x2 group inflated Kish effective size, sqrt(ess/(ess-1)). Without inflation plug-variance group m units deflated (m-1)/m, -covers cells small (example cross-cohorts double ) 2x2 cell fewer 2 effective units group now skipped warning: residual zero, variance estimable standard error understates truth Extended double support M>2 treatment events: cohortvar2 now accepts character vector length M-1 (e.g. c("G2", "G3") three events) Added add_base_period parameter: inserts zero-ATT placeholder base period result_type = "dynamic" results Added experimental options only_est_min only_est_max exper: restrict estimation specific event-time range dynamic mode, skipping g-t pairs outside window Improved input validation: errors negative anticipation/anticipation2, time-varying weights, balanced_event_time exceeding data range Restored parglm dependency multi-threaded propensity score estimation; thread count automatically matched getDTthreads() (1 parallel = TRUE) Various bug fixes robustness improvements double aggregation weight handling
